svg.title: parity-deriva · medium deployment (3 servers)
svg.desc: Server 1 runs archive and test, server 2 demo trading, server 3 real trading. The archive pushes strategies to both trading servers, which send results and trade status back over MCP.
svg.text: archive and test together; demo and real each on their own server
execute strategies on the demo account
sends results and trade status to the archive
AI reads the trade data, read-only
execute strategies on the live account
sends results and trade status to the archive
AI reads the trade data, read-only
MCP · results, trade status from real
archive → demo / real, only by push
results, trade status, strategies to test
from archive only · S3, Drive, OneDrive…
one application, configured with a different role on each server
you + AI over MCP: archive (strategies, indicators), test (tuning), demo and real
demo and real always on separate servers, for performance and security
backup via rclone: S3, Google Drive, OneDrive or any remote; only the archive
one application · four roles · build, test, trade
